mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.room_id, r.number AS room_number, o.channel_id, c.name AS channel_name, o.creator_id, cr.name AS creator_name, o.check_in, o.check_out, o.status, a.paid_amount, a.platform_fee, a.platform_commission, a.extra_commission, a.net_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN room r ON r.id = o.room_id INNER JOIN channels c ON c.id = o.channel_id LEFT JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = o.creator_id INNER JOIN order_amount a ON a.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> #{cancelledStatus} AND o.check_in < #{monthEnd} AND o.check_out > #{monthStart} ORDER BY o.check_in, o.id
SELECT room_id, start_date, end_date FROM room_block WHERE start_date < #{monthEnd} AND end_date > #{monthStart} ORDER BY room_id, start_date, id
